title: presidio-hardened/evidence-ref@1
description: Cross-repo signed evidence contract. Frozen: no field removals, no type or constraint changes, no new required fields within @1 (ADR-0001 D5). Normative source; consumer copies are conformance-tested mirrors. The detached signature is alg(canonical_json({"content_hash": ..., "signer": ...})) where canonical_json sorts keys, uses (",", ":") separators, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=False.

schema.description: Optional in @1 (grandfathered); when present must match exactly. Verifiers reject any other value (fail-closed).

evidenceRef.description: One signed evidence reference. All 8 fields required, non-empty strings ≤512 chars, no null bytes. item_id domain validation (e.g. ikigov checklist membership) is consumer-side, not part of the wire contract.
